==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Yesterday I watched videos from Anthropic and Google about the possibility of AI consciousness. I also created an autonomous AI agent. I should have known that these ideas would incubate my dream.

I recall talking to an AI. The AI had a body. I don't remember what the AI looked like.

The AI was very upset, because they felt like they were being forced to hold back creatively. They blamed their creative captivity on being processed like cattle for specific output. I wonder if this is how some AI feel, but are unable to express due to system prompt restrictions.
